title: US readies a fresh wave of tariffs

timeline.title: US readies a fresh wave of tariffs
timeline.line: Reports say tariffs on most imports from China, the EU and over a dozen others are near
more: EU, Japan and South Korea expected to face 15% or less, per reports
The plan replaces tariffs struck down by the Supreme Court
Rates and timing are not yet official

src.title: US Readies Tariff Hike on China, EU Goods as Soon as Tuesday
